question: Who among the following is a professional Indian gymnast?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dipa Karmakar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​​​Dipa Karmakar is a professional Indian gymnast.
 
• She won a bronze medal at the 2014 Commonwealth Games, Glasgow, and became the first Indian female gymnast to achieve this feat.
 
• She also won a bronze medal at the **Asian Gymnastics Championships.**
 
• She became the first Indian to represent India in gymnastics in the Olympics Games in the year 2016.
 
• She is also one of the only five women who have successfully landed the Produnova vault

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Yashasvi Jaiswal **is an **Indian cricketer.**
 
• **Ngangom Bala Devi **is an **Indian women's footballer.**
 
• **Mary Kom** is an **Indian women's boxer.**

5d:T
